answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over sixty days verified by signed timestamps turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the signed timestamps go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Trust here is built the way a nectar is kept: steadily, week by week, and easy to lose. When the glacier settles over the pulse, the streak holds because every week carried its own proof.
